notes.scope: Draft track catalog and crate configuration copied from game_tracks.csv; the CSV remains the current application source. track_catalog_fields preserve CSV values as strings.
notes.probability: Final per-lootbox probabilities sum to 1 for each Time Trial tier and Ring Rally lap count. Rebalanced selection weights increase Basic, Aku Aku, Life, Slot and Time, and reduce TNT and Infinity; weights were normalized and rounded to 0.01 percentage points. Iron Aku Aku remains less likely than Aku Aku.
notes.quantity: On selection, grant a uniformly random integer between min_quantity and max_quantity inclusive. Compared with the earlier pre-calibration draft, Time Trial and Ring Rally quantities are twice as large.
notes.performance_tiers: Time Trial: strict time comparisons; dev beaten takes priority, otherwise velo beaten, otherwise neither. Ring Rally: no rewards below 5 laps, one to three lootboxes by non-overlapping lap category; probabilities use the exact lap table, capped above maximum. Quantities interpolate linearly between endpoint values, rounding maximum down.
notes.requirements: Each track with Ring Rally requires five selected types; mod tracks have no Ring Rally bonus or unlock requirements. Infinity is a normal crate.
notes.wildcard: Infinity is a normal crate and participates in the same exchange rules as other crates.
notes.reward: The bonus is additive and applies to Ring Rally on this track only; activation timing is undecided.
notes.rarity: Higher rarity values indicate more common crates. The catalog rarity values describe the intended ordering; actual selection uses the explicitly stored probabilities, which include balancing adjustments and Ring Rally lap modifiers.
notes.missing_reference: When a reference time is unavailable, tier selection requires an explicit decision before implementation; do not assume it was beaten.
notes.lap_categories: Categories partition the inclusive interval from 5 to the track maximum as evenly as possible. The final category has no upper bound; its rewards stop increasing at reward_cap_laps. Categories do not modify probabilities.
notes.requirement_balance: Requirements are per track and remain editable. Infinity requires 5 crates, reduced from 10 after its selection probability was lowered; all other requirements retain their previous values.

time_trial.selection: dev_beaten first; otherwise velo_only if velo beaten; otherwise neither

lootbox_model.description: After a race, each reward box selects one crate type and grants a quantity of that type. Multiple boxes may give different crate types.
lootbox_model.selection_probability_conversion: Selection probabilities are stored per Time Trial tier and Ring Rally lap, normalized and rounded to 0.01 percentage points after balancing the reference weights.
lootbox_model.quantity_source: selected crate type and race mode reward rule

crate_exchange.description: Rare crates can yield multiple more-common crates, up to five per crate traded. Existing costs for common-to-rare trades are preserved unless raising them is needed to prevent profitable exchange cycles.
crate_exchange.balancing: Each crate has a relative exchange value equal to round((99 / rarity)^1.75), clamped to 1–5. Every recipe consumes at least as much relative value as it awards. Recipes can be repeated as often as the inventory permits.
